titles.longDescription:
Miro is the visual workspace where teams brainstorm, plan, and build together.

Work with your Miro boards from Microsoft 365 Copilot

Miro brings an agent into Copilot that creates, understands, and acts on your boards in real time. Tell it what you need and it builds it on a board:

  • Run workshops, retros, and planning sessions — spin up a new board and fill it with frames, sticky notes, and starter content in seconds. “Set up a sprint retro board” gives you a ready-to-run space.
  • Generate diagrams — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, ERDs, and user-journey maps from a prompt, PR, or spec. “Diagram this service’s architecture” produces a complete visual.
  • Create documents, tables, and code widgets — capture specs, comparisons, trackers, and review-ready code snippets directly on the canvas.
  • Search your existing boards — surface themes, decisions, and open questions from prior work without leaving chat.
  • Turn discussions into action items — read, reply to, and resolve board comments to close the loop on feedback.

Content is placed with precise layout, and multiple content types can be combined on a single board in one conversation turn. The agent shares a board link so you can open and keep working in Miro.

Work in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork

The same Miro skills plug into Copilot Cowork for agentic, multi-step work alongside your other tools:

  • Browse and ground in boards — explore existing boards to pull themes, decisions, and open questions into the task at hand.
  • Build layouts and content — create boards with frames, sticky notes, shapes, text, cards, docs, and tables, and add images.
  • Generate diagrams — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, ERDs, and journey maps from a prompt.
  • Review code on the canvas — turn a pull request or branch into a visual code review with diagrams and summaries.
  • Capture specs and context — extract product and implementation context to a board to plan and hand off work.
  • Close the loop on feedback — read, reply to, and resolve board comments, and turn discussion into next steps.

Collaborate in Microsoft Teams

  • Meetings — open boards in the side panel or shared stage for real-time brainstorming
  • Tabs — pin boards to channels and group chats
  • Chat — search and share boards as adaptive cards
  • Calendar — attach boards to meeting invites
  • Notifications — get Miro updates in Teams

Security: The Miro agent uses Miro OAuth and respects your existing Miro permissions, so it can only access boards you are authorized to view.

Availability: Available on all Miro plans. An active Miro account is required.

Get started: Sign up for Miro | Getting started guide

Help & support: Miro Help Center | Contact us

enosix arnold™ for Copilot Cowork brings SAP ERP data directly into Microsoft 365 Copilot. Sales teams, customer service representatives, and operations staff can query live SAP data, track orders and deliveries, and initiate document workflows — all without leaving Copilot Chat.

What this app does

  • Order Search — Find open or historical sales orders by customer name, material, or date range.
  • Order Status & Availability — Check delivery status for an order and confirm material stock levels in real time.
  • Billing & Invoice Lookup — Retrieve SAP billing documents and invoice totals for a customer over a date range.
  • Delivery Document Lookup — View outbound delivery documents, shipping status, and delivery dates.
  • PDF Document Download — Generate and download SAP sales order, delivery, invoice, and quote PDFs.
  • Order Cancellation Check — Determine whether a sales order is still eligible for cancellation based on its fulfillment status.
  • Order Update Feasibility — Verify whether a sales order can be modified before requesting a change.
  • Order Quantity Update — Change or cancel a sales order line item quantity directly from Copilot Chat.
  • Quote Creation via Cloud UI — Initiate a new SAP quote for a customer through the enosix Arnold Cloud UI application.

How it works

The app connects to an enosix Arnold MCP server using OAuth 2.0 authentication. Copilot Cowork authenticates once using your Microsoft 365 identity; subsequent sessions refresh automatically. Your SAP data is never replicated — it stays in place in your SAP system and is accessed in real time through the arnold™ platform, with no data replication.

All results are returned directly in Copilot Chat. For richer workflows, arnold™ also supports real-time document reprinting — generating live PDFs of sales orders, invoices, deliveries, and quotes on demand — and integrated Cloud UI components that launch in-context for transactional work like quote and order creation.

Built for enterprise security

enosix Arnold is hosted on Microsoft Azure using managed services and secured through Microsoft Entra ID. Single Sign-On (SSO) and SAP Principal Propagation ensure that every transaction carries the user's SAP identity — preserving document audit trails and enforcing SAP role-based access controls exactly as configured.

Who it's for

Designed for enterprise sales, customer service, and operations teams at organizations running SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA. Industries that benefit include manufacturing, distribution, life sciences, energy, and any SAP-driven enterprise looking to surface ERP data where work happens. This app is intended for use by employees with an active Microsoft 365 Copilot seat and access to a connected enosix Arnold subscription.

Requirements and account setup

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot license
  • enosix Arnold subscription with a connected SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA system

Get started

  • Sign up / Request a demo: https://go.enosix.com/arnold-signup
  • Documentation & Get Started guide: https://go.enosix.com/docs
  • Contact support: https://go.enosix.com/support
  • Privacy policy: https://go.enosix.com/app-privacy-policy

External workflows

Most functionality is delivered directly in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. Two workflows involve content outside of Chat:

  • PDF document download — When a PDF is generated for a sales order, invoice, delivery, or quote, Copilot returns a download link. Clicking the link opens the PDF in your web browser, outside of Teams.
  • Quote creation via Cloud UI — Advanced quote configuration (adding line items, entering PO references) is completed in the enosix Arnold Cloud UI, which opens in a separate browser tab outside of Teams.

No more scrambling to take notes. No more chasing follow-ups. TeamsMaestro joins every Microsoft Teams, other Meet call, captures every word, and delivers a full summary with action items — automatically. Works in 40+ languages.

Powered by ChatGPT (OpenAI) and Claude (Anthropic) for accurate, structured, immediately actionable summaries. Just show up — TeamsMaestro handles the rest.

Why use TeamsMaestro instead of ChatGPT, Claude, etc.?
People forget to start transcription on time, resulting in incomplete notes. Pasting transcripts into a chatbot means extra steps and manual sharing. TeamsMaestro auto-joins your calls and sends structured summaries to all participants — none of your data is ever used to train AI models.

✨ Key benefits

Instant AI meeting notes: Accurate transcripts, structured notes, and summaries after every call — powered by ChatGPT and Claude.

Action items, captured automatically: To-dos, tasks, and next steps extracted from every meeting. Every decision documented, every owner assigned.

Ask TeamsMaestro via Microsoft 365 Copilot: Query your meeting history in natural language via Microsoft 365 Copilot — answered instantly.

Available everywhere: Notes across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 on desktop, mobile, or web.

Automatic sharing: Summaries emailed to all participants. Control privacy settings to decide who gets what.

Pause & resume transcription: Need privacy mid-call? Pause and resume in real time.

Enterprise-grade security: SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, end-to-end encryption, attested by Microsoft and Google. Data never used to train AI models. Visit our Trust Center.

🛠 How it works
  • Install TeamsMaestro on Microsoft Teams
  • Connect your calendar for auto-join
  • Or invite teams@maestrolabs.com to calendar invites
  • TeamsMaestro joins early, takes notes, sends summaries
  • Join active calls on demand from the Teams apps menu
Having trouble? Contact feedback@maestrolabs.com

🔍 FAQs

What AI powers TeamsMaestro?
Transcription engines (Gladia, Assembly, Google, AWS, Microsoft) + ChatGPT (OpenAI) and Claude (Anthropic).

TeamsMaestro vs Microsoft Copilot?
Copilot only takes notes when your company organizes the meeting, and only on Teams. TeamsMaestro works across Teams and other Meets platforms, supports 40+ languages, and costs a fraction of Copilot — while remaining compatible.

TeamsMaestro vs Otter.ai?
Purpose-built for Microsoft Teams with deeper integration, automatic calendar sync, and notes flowing directly into your Microsoft 365 environment.

TeamsMaestro vs Fireflies.ai?
Fireflies.ai is built primarily around other Meet platforms. TeamsMaestro is purpose-built for Microsoft Teams with deeper native integration and notes flowing directly into Microsoft 365.

Is TeamsMaestro secure?
SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR compliant, end-to-end encrypted. Data never used to train AI models. Visit our Trust Center.

With integrations across Microsoft 365, Box makes it easy for users to securely access, share, and collaborate on content directly within their favorite productivity tools. By connecting Box's Intelligent Content Management platform with Microsoft’s communication and AI tools, your organization can break down information silos and work smarter.

Capabilities

Box for Teams:

Keep conversations and files connected in one central place:
  • Share from Box: Seamlessly share Box files to Teams channels and chats, or upload local files directly to a channel's associated Box folder.
  • Box Files Tab: View, preview, and edit all Box content related to a Teams channel in a dedicated tab without leaving the Teams app.
  • Personal Scope: Instantly access and manage your personal Box files, even if they haven't been shared in a specific channel or chat yet.
  • Mobile Compatibility: Upload, preview, and edit your Box files on the go within the Microsoft Teams mobile app for iOS and Android.
Admin Features:
  • Automatic Folder Creation: Automatically creates a dedicated Box folder for both new and existing Teams channels.
  • Automatic Permissions Mapping: Instantly syncs user membership and permissions between Teams channels and their associated Box folders.
  • Content Card Controls: Customize and choose whether shared content cards display file thumbnail previews and additional metadata.

Box AI Agent in Copilot:

Empower your workspace with secure, conversational intelligence over your entire Box content directly inside Microsoft 365 Copilot:
  • Enterprise Search: Search across all your Box files using natural language within Copilot.
  • Smart Summaries: Instantly summarize complex Box documents and extract key takeaways.
  • Contextual Q&A: Get precise, real-time answers to questions based directly on your Box files.
  • Content Generation: Generate drafts, proposals, recommendations, and action items from existing Box documents.

Box Plugin for Copilot Cowork:

The Box Plugin integrates with Copilot Cowork to allow agents to seamlessly connect to, reference, and reason over Box content. Whether in a meeting, in Outlook, or in a document, Copilot can safely retrieve Box files to execute complex tasks on the fly:
  • In Outlook: Pull specific pricing tables from a Box proposal while drafting a client follow-up email.
  • In Teams: Instantly verify if a vendor’s liability insurance stored in Box meets project compliance during a live chat sync.

Availability

  • IT Administrator deployment is required for Microsoft Teams installation.
  • Fully compatible with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
  • For support and inquiries, visit our Box for Microsoft Teams and our Box for Microsoft 365 Copilot support pages.
